problem.description: P9-01 dh-audit of source claims, diagrams and syllabus alignment found three P2 teaching/documentation ambiguities.
symptoms: A17 first draft gave input thresholds but omitted the source syllabus's noise-margin calculation
A21 FSM figure used lines without directional arrowheads
A20 fourth DFF edge had no specified D but the draft answer cell implied Q could be decided

investigation.root_cause: First authoring pass emphasized state tables and input thresholds; the syllabus required output-to-input margins and the visuals had to make transition direction explicit.
sources_checked: TI SNx4HC00 Rev. H sections 6.3 and 6.5, VCC=4.5 V, SN74HC00 -40..85 C and stated output currents
TI SNx4HC151 Rev. F section 7.1, strobe G active low and Y/W behavior
TI SNx4HC74 Rev. F and SN74HC161 Rev. D for edge-triggered DFF and 4-bit synchronous counter
MIT 6.004 2017 sections 5.1 and 6.1 for setup/hold, FSM and metastability

changes: Added guaranteed VOH/VOL-based DC noise margins to A17 with VCC, temperature and load conditions; updated independent exercise and source ledger
Added arrowheads to all three A21 advance=1 transitions and explained the separate hypothetical hold inequality without claiming hold signoff for the setup example
Changed A20 fourth-edge Q to undetermined because D was not given
Clarified SN74HC151 G low to enable and forced Y/W outputs when G is high
resolution.remaining: Physical IC/board design, gate-level timing, hold for the concrete path and asynchronous input synchronization remain pending. No confirmed P0/P1 in the published digital/table scope.
